title: RefreshStatus
description: One refresh: scan progress, ranking and outcome (`GET /api/v1/dashboard/refreshes/{id}`, SSE `refresh`).

judged.description: Items the LLM judged in this refresh.

reused.description: Items whose stored judgement was reused at no cost (judged inputs unchanged).

left_provisional.description: Items left provisional by the per-refresh or daily ranking limit.

scanned_at.description: When the scan finished and the snapshot was stored; null while scanning or when it failed.

ranking.description: The LLM ranking of the snapshot; null before the scan finished.

failure.description: Why the scan failed; null unless `failed`.

log.description: Plain log lines of the scan (at most 200, oldest first); no tokens, no query strings.

RefreshId.description: Identifier of a dashboard refresh (one scan and its ranking).

oneOf.description: The user's Refresh action.
The daily schedule.
My work was open and the newest refresh was old (plan §M).

RefreshState.description:
State of a refresh; transitions in `docs/contracts/http-api.md` "Refresh states". At most one refresh per user
is `scanning` or `ranking`; only `ranking` and `finished` refreshes hold a snapshot.

oneOf.description: Reading GitHub and MemCan; no snapshot yet.
The snapshot is stored and current; the LLM judges new and changed items.
The snapshot is current; the ranking ended with the outcome in `ranking.state`.
The scan failed before its snapshot was complete; the previous snapshot stays.
The scan was cancelled before its snapshot was complete; the previous snapshot stays.

ScanStep.description: A step of the scan, shown as a list with progress.

done.description: Units done (e.g. PR details read); null when the step has no count.

total.description: Units in total; null when not known yet or not counted.

detail.description: Plain detail, e.g. the item being read or why the step failed.

oneOf.description: Pull request searches (authored, assigned, review requested).
Issue searches (watched repositories, assigned, mentions).
Pull request details (CI, reviews, threads, timeline).
Ownership policies, releases, milestones, reach.
Pull request and review history for the charts.
MemCan TODOs.
LLM ranking of new and changed items.
Not started.
In progress.
Done.
Failed; `detail` says why.
Not run (e.g. TODOs switched off).

RankingStatus.description: The LLM ranking of a stored snapshot.

total.description: Items queued for judgement in this refresh.

resumes_at.description: When a usage-limit pause ends; null unless `paused`.

message.description: Plain text of a failure; null unless `failed` or `interrupted`.

RankingState.description: State of the LLM ranking (plan §B.3); the last four end it and leave the refresh `finished`.

oneOf.description: Queued behind a review analysis that holds the LLM credential.
Judging.
Paused by the provider's usage limit; continues by itself at `resumes_at`.
Failed; provisional scores stay approximate (Retry ranking).
Stopped by a server restart (Retry ranking).
Cancelled by the user (Retry ranking).
Done, or nothing needed judging.

retry_at.description: Earliest time a new refresh can succeed (GitHub rate-limit reset); null when not limited.

oneOf.description: GitHub's rate limit; `retry_at` is its reset.
GitHub failed or answered unexpectedly.
The user's GitHub sign-in is no longer usable; sign in again.
The refresh took longer than its limit (5 minutes).
A server restart interrupted the scan.
Anything else.
